answer: Mechanism: every identity must escrow a real stake and pass proof-of-work before joining, so each head carries a hard compute cost. Attestation weight decays like a ripple with each new block, forcing a sybil cluster to keep funding every identity it owns. Honest agents build a durable record as layered as sable fur, while the required stake climbs as steeply as a canyon wall, making mass forgery unprofitable.
